comparison.title: Why Leading Organizations Choose ASTA DIGITAL AGENCY?
comparison.description: Compare how ASTA DIGITAL AGENCY modern software engineering standards outperform conventional agency practices.
comparison.row_1_asta: Clean architecture, modular, and cloud-native designed for long-term scalability without full rewrites.
comparison.row_1_traditional: Rigid monolithic codebase, prone to technical debt and difficult to expand as workload grows.
comparison.row_2_asta: Full semantic structure, Schema.org (JSON-LD) explicit facts, and server-side pre-rendered content for instant AI extraction.
comparison.row_2_traditional: Pure Client-Side Rendering with empty shell tags, hiding actual content from search and AI bots.
comparison.row_3_asta: Strict input sanitization, RBAC access control, data encryption, and OWASP Top 10 hardening.
comparison.row_3_traditional: Minimal security checks, often addressed only after security incidents occur.
comparison.row_4_asta: Contractual post-launch warranty, active uptime monitoring, and guaranteed response SLAs.
comparison.row_4_traditional: Support ends immediately upon delivery, without bug-fixing guarantees.

faq.title: Why Choose ASTA DIGITAL AGENCY?
faq.description: ASTA DIGITAL AGENCY has a highly competent, precise, and punctual IT team. Every project we undertake delivers satisfactory results with 99% precision
faq.a1: ASTA DIGITAL AGENCY has a highly competent, precise, and punctual IT team. Every project we undertake delivers satisfying results with 99% precision.
faq.q2: What does ASTA DIGITAL AGENCY offer?
faq.a2: ASTA DIGITAL AGENCY offers exclusive digital solutions that are custom-designed specifically for your business. Every digital solution we build is custom-made and free from duplication, ensuring your company's systems have a unique identity that's relevant to your business needs.
faq.q3: How can I get a dedicated IT team without the hassle of recruitment?
faq.a3: ASTA DIGITAL AGENCY provides a dedicated team of IT experts ready to work exclusively on your project. Your company can immediately start a digital project without wasting time on an HR screening process, as we directly assign competent experts whose quality and portfolios are guaranteed.
faq.q4: Does ASTA DIGITAL AGENCY guarantee on-time delivery for every website development project?
faq.a4: Absolutely. We're backed by a reliable team with precise project management. We provide a full guarantee of on-time delivery for every system, ensuring projects launch on schedule without compromising the quality or performance of your business systems in the slightest.
